elements.el: Error pages keep the console's nav
The nav on a 421, 500 or 503 page
elements.reason: a 421 came by a name the console does not answer to, so every link on it would hit the same refused Host, and a 500 or a 503 cannot vouch for the session behind the request; these draw the sign-in bar (error-pages.mjs's header)

elements.el: 404: names the id asked for, says where the console looked and why it may be missing, and offers a search pill filled with that id
elements.reason: the run page's own 404 (kind no-run), for an id that every place a run is kept was read for and said it holds none (the record on this host and in the fleet's run mirror, every queue, looked for again after the question, the live transcript and the progress; a place that could not be read keeps the run page, 503, which names it): its sentence says where the console looked (this host's history, the fleet's run mirror and the queue) and why a run may still exist, and the id is only the search field's value, the person's own query, written only when the runs search accepts it; the route's 404 (no-page) still names no path, so a crafted link cannot put its own words on the console's page
it answers to the names it was started with (PI_CONSOLE_ALLOWED_HOSTS may add some), so it cannot say 127.0.0.1 only, and it never lists them

elements.el: 421: names the host the browser asked for
421: the SSH tunnel command to copy
400: the field it could not use, by name, and a way back
elements.shows: so it read nothing: before must be
elements.reason: the parser's refusal names the parameter, set in the code face, and never its value

elements.holds: The console could not find what this address points to.
elements.reason: the card's preview draws it ("Page not found", then the line); each kind says its own

elements.el: The same CSP and escaping as every page
The API keeps answering in JSON
The status and a fixed sentence from the reason catalog

elements.reason: on the run page's 404 alone, as its search field's value, escaped by html, and only when the runs search accepts it (at most 200 characters of an id's or a target's letters, a run id's own bound), else the field is empty; it is in no title, heading or sentence, and no other 404 carries a value from the request
the normalized hostname, escaped and cut to HOST_SHOWN_MAX characters

sample values: the run 404 golden asks for gh-7777, the page prints the request's own Host and the port the connection reached (the 421 golden asks for myhost.lan and 7788), and the tunnel names <this host>, never a host the console knows
